what: Agilent Technologies makes laboratory instruments and the consumables and software around them: chromatographs, mass spectrometers, cell analysis tools and diagnostic reagents used in pharmaceutical, chemical, food and environmental laboratories.
customers: Pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, contract research organisations, chemical and energy companies, academic laboratories and clinical diagnostics providers.
money: liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry, pathology reagents
instruments for chemical, energy, food and environmental testing
moat: Instruments validated into regulated laboratory methods, where changing supplier means revalidating procedures with regulators.
risks: Pharmaceutical customers cut instrument spending sharply in the last two years
Chinese demand for laboratory equipment has been weak
Revenue has been flat over three years
opportunities: About half of revenue is recurring consumables and service, which holds up when instrument sales fall
Operating margin of 21% with return on invested capital of 13%
A recovery in pharmaceutical capital spending would lift instrument orders
watch: Instrument order growth and demand in China.
